    AI Overview
    Portugal defeated the United States 2-0 in a March 31, 2026, international friendly in Atlanta, with goals from Francisco Trincão and João Félix
    . The USMNT, managed by Mauricio Pochettino, experimented with a false-nine formation, starting Christian Pulisic in a striker role behind a 4-3-2-1 setup, while Portugal utilized a 4-3-3. 
    USMNT Starting Lineup (4-3-2-1): 
    • GK: Matt Freese
    • DEF: Alex Freeman (sub: Gio Reyna, 79'), Chris Richards (C), Auston Trusty (sub: Mark McKenzie, 90+1'), Antonee Robinson (sub: Max Arfsten, 46')
    • MID: Aidan Morris (sub: Cristian Roldan, 79'), Sebastian Berhalter (sub: Brenden Aaronson, 79'), Weston McKennie (sub: Tanner Tessman, 45')
    • FWD: Tim Weah (sub: Folarin Balogun, 67'), Malik Tillman (sub: Joe Scally, 67'), Christian Pulisic (sub: Patrick Agyemang, 46')
    • Coach: Mauricio Pochettino 
    Portugal Starting Lineup (4-3-3): 
    • GK: Jose Sa (sub: Ricardo Velho, 85')
    • DEF: Diogo Dalot (sub: Matheus Nunes, 46'), Tomas Araujo (sub: Antonio Silva, 46'), Goncalo Inacio (sub: Renato Veiga, 70'), Joao Cancelo (sub: Nuno Mendes, 46')
    • MID: Samu Costa (sub: Ricardo Horta, 46'), Vitinha (sub: Ruben Neves, 46'), Bruno Fernandes (C) (sub: Mateus Fernandes, 85')
    • FWD: Francisco Trincao (sub: Francisco Conceição, 46'), Pedro Neto (sub: Joao Felix, 46'), Goncalo Ramos (sub: Paulinho, 61')
    • Coach: Roberto Martinez 
    Key Match Facts 
    • Scorers: Francisco Trincão (36'), João Félix (57' - assist by Bruno Fernandes)
    • Substitutions: Portugal made extensive changes, including 7 subs in the second half, while the U.S. modified their front line and midfield at halftime.
    • Notable Absences: Cristiano Ronaldo was not involved in the Portugal squad for this match.
